# atittle.com

> atittle.com is a web design and development studio based in Kolkata, India, building fast, mobile-first websites for Indian small and medium businesses — real estate developers, hotels and resorts, healthcare clinics, coaching institutes, dental clinics, restaurants, jewellers, interior designers, and salons & spas — with transparent INR pricing and a WhatsApp-first response commitment.

atittle.com does not build login systems, user accounts, or payment checkouts, and does not guarantee specific search-engine rankings. Pricing starts around ₹25,000 for a brochure site and scales with scope; exact quotes are given after a short scoping conversation.

## Demos

Nine full working demo websites, one per industry above, built for fictional example businesses to demonstrate design and engineering quality (index: [/demos](/demos)). These are not real, currently-operating companies.

## Tools

- [AI Website Brand Alignment Evaluator](/tools/website-evaluator): a free tool that scores whether a business's existing website copy reflects its genuine trade craft, across value proposition, industry authenticity, trust signals, pricing transparency, and mobile actionability.
